Question: Given the Laplace transform of i(t), L[i(t)] = I(s) = [{{E - V(0^+)}} / {{R(s + (1 / RC))}}] Determine i(0^+).

Options:

B. [{{v(0^+) - E}} / R]
C. [{{E * v(0^+)}} / R]
D. [{{E - v(0^+)}} * R]
E. [{{E * R}} / {{v(0^+) - 1}}]
F. [{{E + R}} / {{v(0^+) + RC}}]
G. [{{(E - v(0^+)) / (R + RC)}}]
H. [{{E + v(0^+)}} / R]
I. [{{E * (v(0^+) + 1)}} / R]
J. [{{E - v(0^+)}} / R]

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
